question: Are Otto and Patrasche good friends?
answer: Patrasche won’t be good friends with anyone besides Subaru.  He’s a friend of Subaru, so she thinks “It can’t be helped, I suppose.  I’ll make an exception.” and interacts with him.  Hence, it’s difficult to say that Otto and Patrasche are good friends… She simply thinks of him as someone she can use to pass on words to Subaru.
